simple.summary: מְנָא (mᵉnâʼ) means to count , appoint First listed occurrence: Dan 2 24.

definitions.full: H4483. mena or menah מְנָה verb number, reckon (see Biblical Hebrew); — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine singular ׳מ Dan 5:26 God has numbered (the days of) thy kingdom (accusative; i.e. put an end to it); — מְנֵא see below Pa`el appoint , accusative of person: Perfect 3masculine singular מַנִּי Dan 2:24 (+ Infinitive), 2:49 ( ל person + עַל of thing); 2 masculine singular מִבִּיתָ 3:12 ( עַל of thing); Imperative masculine singular מֶנִּי (K §, 47, 3 , c )) Ezra 7:25 .
